title: Ericsson to utilize mandate to transfer shares
summary: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson (publ)’s (“Ericsson”) Annual General Meeting on March 31, 2026 authorized the company to transfer no more than 3,500,000 Class B shares on a stock exchange to cover certain payments, mainly social security payments, which may occur in relation to the long-term variable compensation programs LTV I 2023, LTV II 2023 and LTV 2024. Ericsson has decided to utilize this authorization for LTV I and II 2023
body_markdown:
The transfer of these shares may take place on Nasdaq Stockholm during the period from and including November 30, 2026, up to the Annual General Meeting 2027, at a price within the price interval registered from time to time.


Ericsson’s current holding of treasury stock amounts to 132,915,894 Class B shares. The maximum number of shares that may be transferred on Nasdaq Stockholm pursuant to the decision to utilize the authorization is 3,500,000 Class B shares.
